Crop of one slip from a Players Committee Virtual card sheet, showing the label above the slip and the margin note beside the slip number, for [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]]: the label prints "•IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V)" with the letter O; the margin note prints "•IT-0 (Eyetee-Oh) (V)" with a zero (the PDF text layer has the digit 0).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf], Virtual Set 3 Remaster sheet, page 4, slip 37. Internet Archive copy of 24 October 2007.

Edits: the slip area was rendered from the PDF at 216 dpi and cropped; nothing else changed. Used on [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#Slip labels and margin notes]].

Fair use rationale: a low-resolution excerpt of a Players Committee fan document showing copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game artwork (© Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to document the printed text on this non-commercial fan wiki.
